meanings.en: having great influence on someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She is one of the most influential figures in modern art.
meanings.exampleTr: O, modern sanattaki en etkili kişilerden biridir.

meanings.en: a common infectious disease that causes fever and weakness
meanings.exampleEn: He was off work for a week with influenza.
meanings.exampleTr: Grip yüzünden bir hafta işe gidemedi.

meanings.en: relaxed and friendly, not official or formal
meanings.exampleEn: It was an informal meeting with no fixed agenda.
meanings.exampleTr: Belirli bir gündemi olmayan gayri resmi bir toplantıydı.

meanings.en: to break a law or rule, or to limit someone's rights
meanings.exampleEn: The company was accused of infringing on its rival's patent.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, rakibinin patentini ihlal etmekle suçlandı.

meanings.en: an act of breaking a law or rule
meanings.exampleEn: Copying the software is a clear infringement of copyright.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılımı kopyalamak açık bir telif hakkı ihlalidir.

meanings.en: to live in a particular place
meanings.exampleEn: These forests are inhabited by many rare species.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ormanlarda birçok nadir tür yaşar.

meanings.en: to receive money, property, or traits from someone
meanings.exampleEn: She inherited the house from her grandmother.
meanings.exampleTr: Evi büyükannesinden miras aldı.

meanings.en: happening at the beginning; first
meanings.exampleEn: My initial reaction was one of surprise.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk tepkim şaşkınlık oldu.

meanings.en: the act of putting a drug into the body using a needle
meanings.exampleEn: The nurse gave him an injection to ease the pain.
meanings.exampleTr: Hemşire ağrısını dindirmek için ona bir iğne yaptı.

meanings.en: physically hurt or harmed
meanings.exampleEn: The injured player was carried off the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaralı oyuncu sahadan taşınarak çıkarıldı.

meanings.en: existing in a person from birth; natural
meanings.exampleEn: She has an innate talent for music.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun müziğe karşı doğuştan gelen bir yeteneği var.

meanings.en: in a way that shows no guilt or harmful intent
meanings.exampleEn: The child smiled innocently at the stranger.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk yabancıya masumca gülümsedi.

meanings.en: a new idea, method, or product
meanings.exampleEn: The smartphone was a major technological innovation.
meanings.exampleTr: Akıllı telefon büyük bir teknolojik yenilikti.

meanings.en: introducing or using new ideas or methods
meanings.exampleEn: The company is known for its innovative designs.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket yenilikçi tasarımlarıyla tanınır.

meanings.en: to ask for information about something
meanings.exampleEn: I called the office to inquire about the job opening.
meanings.exampleTr: İş ilanını sormak için ofisi aradım.

meanings.en: unable to be separated or treated apart
meanings.exampleEn: The two friends were inseparable throughout school.
meanings.exampleTr: İki arkadaş okul boyunca birbirinden ayrılmazdı.

meanings.en: located on or in the inner part of something
meanings.exampleEn: The inside pages of the book were torn.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitabın iç sayfaları yırtılmıştı.

meanings.en: to look at something carefully to check it
meanings.exampleEn: The mechanic inspected the engine for faults.
meanings.exampleTr: Tamirci motoru arızalara karşı inceledi.

meanings.en: an official who checks that rules are being followed
meanings.exampleEn: A health inspector visited the restaurant yesterday.
meanings.exampleTr: Dün restorana bir sağlık müfettişi geldi.

meanings.en: making you feel motivated or full of hope
meanings.exampleEn: Her speech was truly inspirational.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşması gerçekten ilham vericiydi.

meanings.en: immediately, without any delay
meanings.exampleEn: She recognized him instantly.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu anında tanıdı.

meanings.en: to gradually put ideas or feelings into someone
meanings.exampleEn: Her parents instilled a love of reading in her.
meanings.exampleTr: Anne babası ona okuma sevgisi aşıladı.

meanings.en: a natural tendency to behave in a certain way
meanings.exampleEn: Animals rely on instinct to survive.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayvanlar hayatta kalmak için içgüdüye güvenir.

meanings.en: a large important organization such as a bank or university
meanings.exampleEn: The university is one of the country's oldest institutions.
meanings.exampleTr: Üniversite, ülkenin en eski kurumlarından biridir.

meanings.en: to tell someone to do something, or to teach them
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen öğrencilere kitaplarını açmalarını söyledi.

meanings.en: not enough for a particular purpose
meanings.exampleEn: There was insufficient evidence to convict him.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu mahkum etmek için yetersiz kanıt vardı.

meanings.en: a rude remark that offends someone
meanings.exampleEn: He took her comment as a personal insult.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun yorumunu kişisel bir hakaret olarak aldı.

meanings.en: to combine things so they work together as a whole
meanings.exampleEn: The new software integrates well with existing systems.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yazılım mevcut sistemlerle iyi bütünleşiyor.

meanings.en: relating to the ability to think and understand ideas
meanings.exampleEn: The book offers a serious intellectual challenge.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap ciddi bir entelektüel meydan okuma sunuyor.

meanings.en: determined to do something, or concentrating hard
meanings.exampleEn: She was intent on finishing the project by Friday.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi cuma gününe kadar bitirmeye kararlıydı.

meanings.en: allowing two-way communication between a user and a system
meanings.exampleEn: The museum has an interactive exhibit for children.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzede çocuklar için etkileşimli bir sergi var.

meanings.en: to get involved in a situation where you are not wanted
meanings.exampleEn: Please don't interfere in my personal affairs.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen kişisel işlerime karışma.

meanings.en: the inside part of something
meanings.exampleEn: The interior of the car was clean and spacious.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabanın iç kısmı temiz ve genişti.

meanings.en: relating to relationships between people
meanings.exampleEn: Good interpersonal skills are essential for this job.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu iş için iyi kişiler arası beceriler şarttır.

meanings.en: to explain the meaning of something
meanings.exampleEn: How do you interpret these test results?
meanings.exampleTr: Bu test sonuçlarını nasıl yorumluyorsun?

meanings.en: an explanation of the meaning of something
meanings.exampleEn: There are several interpretations of this poem.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu şiirin birkaç yorumu vardır.

meanings.en: a person who translates spoken language from one to another
meanings.exampleEn: The diplomat spoke through an interpreter.
meanings.exampleTr: Diplomat bir tercüman aracılığıyla konuştu.

meanings.en: an act of stopping something for a short time
meanings.exampleEn: The meeting continued without interruption.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı kesintisiz devam etti.

meanings.en: a place where two roads or lines cross
meanings.exampleEn: Turn left at the next intersection.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir sonraki kavşaktan sola dön.

meanings.en: having a close and friendly relationship
meanings.exampleEn: They shared an intimate dinner for two.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kişilik samimi bir akşam yemeği yediler.

meanings.en: describing a verb that does not take a direct object
meanings.exampleEn: The verb 'arrive' is intransitive.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Arrive' fiili geçişsizdir.

meanings.en: going into or through a vein
meanings.exampleEn: The patient was given fluids through an intravenous drip.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastaya damar içi serumla sıvı verildi.

meanings.en: to enter a place or situation where you are not wanted
meanings.exampleEn: I didn't mean to intrude on your conversation.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşmanızı bölmek niyetinde değildim.

meanings.en: a person who enters a place without permission
meanings.exampleEn: The alarm scared the intruder away.
meanings.exampleTr: Alarm davetsiz misafiri korkutup kaçırdı.

meanings.en: the act of entering a place or affecting a situation uninvited
meanings.exampleEn: She saw the questions as an intrusion into her private life.
meanings.exampleTr: Soruları, özel hayatına bir müdahale olarak gördü.

meanings.en: never changing; always the same
meanings.exampleEn: His invariable response was a polite refusal.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun değişmez yanıtı kibar bir reddetme oldu.

meanings.en: always; on every occasion
meanings.exampleEn: He invariably arrives late to meetings.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantılara her zaman geç gelir.

meanings.en: a person who creates something new
meanings.exampleEn: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
meanings.exampleTr: Thomas Edison ünlü bir mucitti.

meanings.en: the punctuation marks used to show speech or quotation
meanings.exampleEn: Put the quoted words inside inverted commas.
meanings.exampleTr: Alıntılanan sözcükleri tırnak işareti içine al.

meanings.en: to examine something carefully to find the truth
meanings.exampleEn: The police are investigating the cause of the fire.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis yangının nedenini araştırıyor.

meanings.en: a person who examines a crime or problem officially
meanings.exampleEn: A private investigator was hired to find the missing man.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıp adamı bulmak için özel bir dedektif tutuldu.

meanings.en: money put into something to make a profit
meanings.exampleEn: Buying the house proved to be a good investment.
meanings.exampleTr: Evi satın almak iyi bir yatırım oldu.

meanings.en: a person or company that invests money
meanings.exampleEn: The startup attracted several large investors.
meanings.exampleTr: Girişim birkaç büyük yatırımcı çekti.

meanings.en: unable to be seen
meanings.exampleEn: Germs are invisible to the naked eye.
meanings.exampleTr: Mikroplar çıplak gözle görünmez.

meanings.en: in a way that is attractive or tempting
meanings.exampleEn: The warm bread smelled invitingly of fresh herbs.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcak ekmek cazip biçimde taze ot kokuyordu.

meanings.en: to use a law or rule, or to call on for support
meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer invoked an old law to defend his client.
meanings.exampleTr: Avukat müvekkilini savunmak için eski bir yasaya başvurdu.

meanings.en: the act of taking part in something
meanings.exampleEn: His involvement in the project was crucial.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun projeye katılımı çok önemliydi.

meanings.en: in a way that is the opposite of what is expected
meanings.exampleEn: Ironically, the fire station itself caught fire.
meanings.exampleTr: İronik biçimde, itfaiyenin kendisi yangın çıkardı.

meanings.en: not based on clear thought or reason
meanings.exampleEn: She has an irrational fear of spiders.
meanings.exampleTr: Örümceklere karşı mantıksız bir korkusu var.

meanings.en: too attractive or strong to be resisted
meanings.exampleEn: The smell of the cake was irresistible.
meanings.exampleTr: Kekin kokusu karşı konulmazdı.

meanings.en: in a way that is too strong to resist
meanings.exampleEn: She was irresistibly drawn to the bright lights.
meanings.exampleTr: Parlak ışıklara karşı konulmaz biçimde çekiliyordu.

meanings.en: not showing care about the consequences of actions
meanings.exampleEn: It was irresponsible to leave the children alone.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukları yalnız bırakmak sorumsuzcaydı.

meanings.en: feeling annoyed or slightly angry
meanings.exampleEn: He was irritated by the constant noise.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli gürültüden rahatsız olmuştu.

meanings.en: making you feel annoyed
meanings.exampleEn: His habit of interrupting is really irritating.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözü kesme alışkanlığı gerçekten sinir bozucu.

meanings.en: the feeling of being annoyed, or a sore physical reaction
meanings.exampleEn: She sighed with irritation at the delay.
meanings.exampleTr: Gecikme yüzünden sinirle içini çekti.

meanings.en: a person who lives on an island
meanings.exampleEn: The islanders rely mostly on fishing.
meanings.exampleTr: Adalılar çoğunlukla balıkçılığa bağımlıdır.

meanings.en: to print or write words in italic letters
meanings.exampleEn: Please italicize the titles of all books.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen tüm kitap başlıklarını italik yazın.

meanings.en: to have an uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch
meanings.exampleEn: My arm started to itch after the insect bite.
meanings.exampleTr: Böcek ısırığından sonra kolum kaşınmaya başladı.

meanings.en: either of the two bony parts of the face that hold the teeth
meanings.exampleEn: He broke his jaw in the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazada çenesini kırdı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows envy or protective desire
meanings.exampleEn: She jealously guarded her position in the company.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketteki konumunu kıskançlıkla korudu.
